summary: The CCNP pilot stage (2013-2022) is a longitudinal study establishing protocols for Chinese normative brain development trajectories across the human lifespan, comprising three connected components: devCCNP (ages 6-18), matCCNP (ages 18-60), and ageCCNP (ages 60-84). The developmental component, devCCNP, is a ten-year pilot stage focused on typically developing Chinese children and adolescents, collecting longitudinal data on demographics, biophysical measures, psychological and behavioral assessments, cognitive phenotyping, ocular-tracking, and multimodal MRI (including T1-weighted, resting-state fMRI, and Diffusion Tensor MRI) data. This dataset is available to researchers after completing a Data Use Agreement and is hosted on the International Data-sharing Neuroimaging Initiative (INDI) through the Consortium for Reliability and Reproducibility (CoRR).
